application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Details submitted pursuant to reference 22/01816/FUL for Construction Management Plan (3) and Drainage Strategy (12) in respect of the demolition of  existing garages and redevelopment of the land comprising a terrace of 4 x two storey and 1 x three storey dwellings with rooftop private amenity space, with an associated cycle store and a refuse store.
decision_conditions: The details submitted are insufficient to satisfy the discharge of condition 12 (Drainage Strategy) of planning permission ref: 22/01816/FUL as the proposed Drainage Strategy fails to demonstrate how proposed measures successfully utilise Sustainable Urban Drainage Systems (SuDS) following the drainage hierarchy in the London Plan. The proposal is therefore contray to policy DMD61 of the Development Management Document (2014).
